description: Shopee Seller Centre Sales Info Mass Update template specifications and structural invariants.
invariants: Rows 1 through 6 are template metadata, instructions, and header definitions. They must be preserved exactly without modification.
Data rows begin strictly at Row 7 (index 7 in 1-based Excel row indexing).
Product ID and Variation ID must be treated as strings to avoid scientific notation truncation (e.g., 4.77684E+10).
Every row starting from Row 7 must be evaluated and accounted for during reconciliation.
